parent_scope: N7.4 — Idempotencia e integraciones externas — MODEL

facts: ClaveIdempotencia is mandatory, trimmed, bounded to 200 characters and immutable after creation.
EventoId is generated as a durable event identity.
The state machine prevents terminal Delivered/DeadLetter messages from being claimed again.
Directed tests reject missing tenant and blank idempotency key.
Directed tests verify normalization and terminal/retry invariants.

model_contract.tenant_scope: EmpresaId is part of the idempotency boundary.
model_contract.durable_key: ClaveIdempotencia is required and normalized once when the durable intent is created.
model_contract.duplicate_semantics: Within the same EmpresaId, a repeated ClaveIdempotencia represents the same idempotency identity and must not create a second durable intent; a conflicting attempt is rejected rather than silently creating a new effect.
model_contract.provider_contract_boundary: The existing domain model already carries the durable identity required by an external provider. Propagation/translation into a concrete provider request is an Application/Infrastructure responsibility for N7.4.D, not a missing DOMAIN invariant.
model_contract.retry_contract: Retries reuse the same MensajeOutbox and therefore the same ClaveIdempotencia; no retry should mint a new provider idempotency identity.

reason_no_product_patch: The required MODEL invariants already exist and are covered by directed domain tests; adding a duplicate value object or parallel identity field would create filler without changing the acceptance contract.
risks_carried_forward: N7.4.D must prove a concrete dispatcher/provider adapter forwards the durable key.
N7.4.G must prove replay after provider success/local confirmation failure produces one external effect.

review_first.notes: MODEL acceptance is already satisfied by existing durable tenant+key invariants. The unproven provider-side propagation identified by N7.4.A belongs to the integration implementation/test stages and is not a missing domain invariant.
